provenance.method: Actual WebGPU canvas; exact previous-B1 WGSL and solar payload replay in the same verified host bundle. No image composition.

motion.method: 120 sequential saved camera/time frames at fixed exposure/resolution, then a separately settled scene transition and 40 Earth-limb samples with labelled exposure/resize controls. Every PNG is a newly rendered canvas frame; renderer frame IDs expose any intervening setup frames. Solar-tangent aligned samples exclude the disc.
